# Support Resources for LookSphere

Thank you for using LookSphere! We are committed to providing helpful support and fostering a welcoming community.

Before opening a new issue, please check the resources below to find quick answers to common questions or reach out through our community channels.

---

## 🔍 Self-Help & Documentation

1. **[README.md](../Readme.md)**: Project overview, prerequisites, and setup instructions.
2. **[Backend Documentation](../Backend/Readme.md)**: API endpoints, server setup, and configuration.
3. **[Frontend Documentation](../frontend/README.md)**: Architecture, components, and client-side setup.
4. **[Resolved Issues](../Resolved_Issues.md)**: Known bug resolutions, testing notes, and troubleshooting.
5. **[Performance Optimization](../Performance_Optimization.md)**: Tips and guidelines for system performance.

---

## 💬 Community Channels & Questions

If you have general usage questions, ideas, or need guidance:

- **Website Contact**: [LookSphere Contact Us](https://looksphere.vercel.app/contact-us)

## 🐛 Reporting Bugs & Requesting Features

- If you found a repeatable bug, please open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/PRANAV-SHILU/LookSphere/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
- If you have an idea for a new feature, please open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/PRANAV-SHILU/LookSphere/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).

---

## 🔒 Security Vulnerabilities

Please **do not** report sensitive security vulnerabilities publicly in GitHub Issues.  
Refer to our **[Security Policy](../SECURITY.md)** for instructions on private, responsible disclosure.
